Context: REPLACEMENT NO.

Other instructions:(i) Crouping of posts.If the total number of posts in any cadre or grade is below 20, they should be grouped with posts in the same group, i.e., Group 'A', 'B', 'C' or MTS, taking into account the status, salary, qualifications, etc. A group should not ordinarily consist of less than 25 posts.
